item.tib: bdud rtsi rol du gsod pa'i yig chung me drod
item.coloph: rten 'brel rdzas kyi drod sgrub 'di/ gshen rab dpyad bus/ khye'u dgongs pa 'dzin pa la brgyud/ gshen rab stong ldan nam mkha' che la gnang*/ desaM 'phrul gshen snang ldan la brgyud/ des rgya gar gyi gshen po don ldan g.yung drung snying po dang / mkha' 'gro ma 'od kyi rgyal mo la brgyud/ des gshen po dran pa la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma la brgyud/ yab yum de gnyis kyis g.yung drung nam mkha' sgron gsal la brgyud pa'o/ phyi rabs gshen po'i don du/ lus la bde drod dbab cing me rtag lus la bca' ba/ u ya/ ag tham//
